name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Candidates

rules.name: Mandatory ST Caste Category
rules.public_explanation: Candidate ST status not confirmed on certificate.

rules.name: Family Income Ceiling (₹8.0 Lakhs)
rules.public_explanation: Annual family income exceeds the limit of ₹8,00,000 for National Overseas Scholarship.

rules.name: Minimum Qualifying Degree Marks (55%)
rules.public_explanation: Candidate must secure at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in the qualifying degree.

rules.name: QS World University Ranking (Top 500)
rules.public_explanation: Admission must be in an overseas institution ranked within the top 500 in QS World Rankings.

rules.name: Valid Unconditional Offer Letter
rules.public_explanation: An unconditional admission offer letter from the foreign university is mandatory.
